WITH memberships AS (
  SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack
  UNION
  SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member
),
pack_documents AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.id, d.number
  FROM memberships AS m
  JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = m.pack_id
  JOIN document AS d ON d.id = m.cr
  WHERE p.pack_number = 'RP-221603' AND d.number LIKE 'R1-%'
)
SELECT x.code AS disposition, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS document_count
FROM pack_documents AS d
JOIN disposition AS x ON x.target = d.id
WHERE x.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND x.scope = 'whole_target'
GROUP BY x.code
ORDER BY disposition;

FROM counts
WHERE clause_count = (SELECT MAX(clause_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY document;

WITH memberships AS (
  SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack
  UNION
  SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member
),
pack_documents AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.id, d.number
  FROM memberships AS m
  JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = m.pack_id
  JOIN document AS d ON d.id = m.cr
  WHERE p.pack_number = 'RP-200066' AND d.number LIKE 'R5-%'
),
links AS (
  SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section
  UNION
  SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by
)
SELECT d.number AS document
FROM pack_documents AS d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM links AS l
  JOIN section AS s ON s.id = l.section_id
  WHERE l.cr = d.id
)
ORDER BY document;
